title: Capture modes, duplicates and corrections
question: Which capture modes does each project type support, and what metadata is required? When is a capture a duplicate or a replacement, and is history kept? Who may correct a capture's date or location, or delete it?
context: Today a capture is reused when device, time and structure match (CAPT-REQ-002), and moving a photo rewrites its position (CAPT-REQ-011). Neither is an approved policy.
